items.title: Guidance Cut Could Change The Case For FIS Stock
items.summary: Fidelity National Information Services reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$3.45b and net income of US$356m, and also affirmed a US$0.44 quarterly dividend payable in late December. The business paired stronger earnings with a lower 2026 outlook, paused buybacks to cut debt, and announced CFO James Kehoe’s departure, which sharpened the focus on execution and balance sheet discipline.
